properties.label: Chapter rail and detail panel
properties.text: Place a narrow numbered chapter rail beside one spacious detail panel. Give the active item a tiny registration line and keep panel title, prose and a short evidence list in one stable layout.

properties.label: Mono indices with calm sans detail
properties.text: Use muted monospace indices in the rail and graphite reading typography in the detail panel.

properties.label: White, graphite and blue registration
properties.text: Use an almost-white ground, white panel, graphite typography and one muted blue registration accent.

properties.label: Restrained raised panel
properties.text: Give the focal panel a restrained radius, broad faint elevation shadow and crisp surface edge without turning the whole page into a panel.

properties.label: Unified chapter selection
properties.text: Support click, keyboard focus and activation, and touch as equivalent ways to select a chapter; rapid selections resolve to the latest choice.

properties.label: Brief in-place dissolve
properties.text: Swap the panel in place with a brief dissolve. Any auto-demo stops after user input and under reduced motion.

properties.label: Longest-chapter acceptance
properties.text: Reserve enough height for the longest chapter, and on mobile keep rail and panel close rather than separating them across the viewport.
